description: Channel the silent depth-pressure of the deep ocean trench, unleashing a massive sonic implosion dealing 12d8 storm damage and deafening all targets. Spends 6 Musical Notes.

resourceCost.somaticText: Climax the piece with a violent, percussive snap of all strings

effects.name: Ruptured Eardrums
effects.description: Deafened and disoriented for 2 rounds.
effects.mechanicsText: Deafened for 2 rounds on failed Fortitude save.

name: Anthem of the Iceheart
description: Perform the lost legendary sea-shanty of Lyris, granting all allies an extra action point each turn, +4 DR, and complete immunity to control effects for 3 rounds. Spends 8 Musical Notes.

resourceCost.somaticText: Play the thunderous sea-rhythm with bleeding fingers

effects.name: Sea-Synchronized
effects.description: +1 AP per turn, +4 DR, and immunity to stun/slow/paralysis for 3 rounds.
effects.mechanicsText: +1 AP, +4 DR, immune to control for 3 rounds.

name: Apotheosis Symphony
description: Ascend to acoustic mastery with a continuous celestial overture: 16d10 storm/wyrd to all enemies across 60ft and 50 HP restored to all allies. Spends 10 Musical Notes.

resourceCost.somaticText: Strike all chords in an explosive cascade that rings across the sky

name: Miasma Form
description: Dissolve your body into a floating green rot-cloud for 10 minutes. Float through keyholes, iron grates, and narrow cracks.

selectedEffects.name: Rot-Cloud Form
selectedEffects.description: Dissolve into a floating green rot-cloud, passing through keyholes, iron grates, and narrow cracks.
selectedEffects.mechanicsText: Gaseous form: squeeze through gaps for 10 minutes.

name: Wasting Curse
description: Plant a seed of decay: 1d6 + intelligence blight now, then 1d6 blight at their turn start for 4 rounds, and the target's affliction stage advances by 1. Cultivates as Decay.

resourceCost.somaticText: Channel plaguebringer through gesture

agonyToll.description: Toll of Flesh: The caster's reserves strain, generating Virulence.

flavorText: A seed of decay planted in the warm meat of the living. It grows, and they weep.

name: Venomous Touch
description: Strike a target with rotting fluid, dealing 1d8 + intelligence blight damage and applying a Stage 0 Seed. Cultivates as a Fester category spell.

resourceCost.somaticText: Channel plaguebringer through gesture

agonyToll.description: Operational Friction: Seizes the caster's hands with toxic palsy, reducing Dodge by 2 for 1 round.

flavorText: A touch that rots the skin like overripe fruit, leaving weeping sores.

name: Whisper of Decay
description: Whisper a tragic dirge into the victim's mind, dealing 1d6 + intelligence wyrd damage. If the target has an active Seed, advance it to Stage 1. Cultivates as a Torment category spell.

agonyToll.description: Toll of Mind: The caster whispers a part of their own sanity away, suffering a -2 penalty to Spirit checks for 1 round.

flavorText: The dry hum of locusts inside the skull. It never stops, repeating the names of the dead.

name: Fever Dream
description: Plunge an infected target into a sweating delirium, dealing 2d6 wyrd damage and reducing Agility by 3 for 3 rounds. Requires an active affliction. Cultivates as a Torment category spell.

resourceCost.somaticText: Channel plaguebringer through gesture

effects.name: Delirium
effects.description: Agility reduced by 3 due to severe sweating and hallucination.

agonyToll.description: Operational Friction: The caster's reserves strain, generating Virulence.

flavorText: Their eyes roll back, witnessing the dark garden blooming behind their eyelids.

name: Mark of the Pestilent
description: Brand a target with a searing sigil of rot, dealing 2d8 blight damage and reducing DR by 5 for 3 rounds. Cultivates as a Weaken category spell.

resourceCost.somaticText: Channel plaguebringer through gesture

effects.name: Pestilent Brand
effects.description: Flesh softens under the mark, reducing DR by 5.

agonyToll.description: Virulence Toll: The brand feeds on the caster's reserves, costing 5 Virulence.

flavorText: The brand of the gardener. You are marked for the sickle, and your shell begins to crack.

name: Enfeebling Fog
description: Exhale a thick, greenish cloud of rot in a 20ft radius. Enemies inside are enfeebled, suffering -4 Strength and -4 Agility. Cultivates active afflictions as Weaken.

resourceCost.somaticText: Channel plaguebringer through gesture

effects.name: Enfeebled
effects.description: Muscles liquefy and joints stiffen, reducing Strength and Agility by 4.

agonyToll.description: Operational Friction: The fog leaks from the caster's own lungs, slowing their movement speed by 5ft for 2 rounds.

flavorText: The air turns sour, thick with the heavy stench of stagnant bogs. Their limbs grow leaden.

name: Drain Vitality
description: Siphon the life force of a diseased enemy, dealing 3d6 blight damage and healing the caster for 50% of the damage dealt. Requires active affliction. Cultivates as a Decay category spell.

resourceCost.somaticText: Channel plaguebringer through gesture

agonyToll.description: Toll of Flesh: To open the siphon, the caster must inject some of their own blood into the link, taking 4 blight damage that cannot be reduced.

flavorText: Your lungs expand as their chest collapses. A sweet, warm thieving of breath.

name: Hallucinogenic Spores
description: Throw a handful of fungal dust in a 15ft radius. Enemies failing a Spirit save are confused for 2 rounds. Cultivates as a Torment category spell.

resourceCost.somaticText: Channel plaguebringer through gesture

effects.name: Spore Confused
effects.description: Spore inhalation causes target to wander aimlessly or attack nearest ally (50% chance).

agonyToll.description: Operational Friction: Spore blowback irritates the caster's mind, imposing disadvantage on Spirit saves for 1 round.

flavorText: A burst of blue, glowing spores. The dust enters their nostrils, and they begin to weep, clawing at invisible bugs.

name: Wail of Decay
description: A tragic scream of despair deals 3d8 wyrd to all enemies in a 15ft cone; targets with 2+ active afflictions lose their reaction next round. Cultivates as Torment.

effects.name: Reaction Lost
effects.description: The overwhelming mental scream deprives the target of their reaction next turn.

agonyToll.description: Operational Friction: The sheer vocal strain sears the caster's throat; they cannot speak or cast verbal spells next turn.

flavorText: It is not a battle cry. It is the howl of a parent losing a child, amplified through the throat of the dead.

name: Infectious Sores
description: Existing infections blister and burst for 2d6 blight. If the target is Stage 1+, the sores rupture, applying Stage 0 Seeds to 2 enemies within 10ft. Cultivates as Fester.

resourceCost.somaticText: Channel plaguebringer through gesture

agonyToll.description: Toll of Flesh: The caster's reserves strain, generating Virulence.

flavorText: Yellow blisters swell rapidly and pop with a wet hiss, spraying infectious rot on bystanders.

name: Plague of Flies
description: Summon a biting black cloud on a target: 2d4 blight per round for 3 rounds; enemies in the swarm have disadvantage on physical attacks. Cultivates as Fester.

resourceCost.somaticText: Channel plaguebringer through gesture

effects.name: Biting Swarm
effects.description: Disadvantage on all physical attacks due to blinding insects.

agonyToll.description: Operational Friction: The ravenous flies bite the caster upon emergence, dealing 3 stabbing damage.

flavorText: A deafening buzz. A million tiny, black bodies swarm the eyes and open sores of the living.

name: Necrotic Burst
description: Detonate the blighted decay in a host, dealing 4d6 blight damage to all enemies in a 15ft radius. Requires a Stage 1+ affliction on the primary host. Cultivates as a Decay category spell.

resourceCost.somaticText: Channel plaguebringer through gesture

agonyToll.description: Operational Friction: The biological shock of the burst rattles the caster, reducing their DR by 2 for 1 round.

flavorText: Flesh swells, turns a deep, bruised purple, then bursts with wet, explosive decay.

name: Wither Touch
description: Touch a target to wither their physical strength, dealing 4d8 blight damage and imposing disadvantage on Strength checks for 2 rounds. Cultivates as a Decay category spell.

resourceCost.somaticText: Channel plaguebringer through gesture

effects.name: Riven Muscles
effects.description: Target's tendons rot, giving disadvantage on Strength checks.

agonyToll.description: Operational Friction: The caster's own hand rots temporarily, giving disadvantage on Strength checks for 2 rounds.

flavorText: Flesh falls away under your grasp, revealing gray, crumbling bone.

name: Dark Rejuvenation
description: Drain 2d10 HP from your active afflictions to heal yourself. Triggers a self-debuff reducing all stats by 2 for 2 rounds. Cultivates as a Torment category spell.

resourceCost.somaticText: Channel plaguebringer through gesture

effects.name: Rejuvenation Rot
effects.description: Caster's body is poisoned by the harvested rot, reducing all stats by 2.

agonyToll.description: Toll of Sanity: Healing with stolen sickness induces a self-debuff, reducing all attributes by 2 for 2 rounds.

flavorText: You swallow their sickness to mend your bones, but their fever now burns inside your own heart.

name: Suffering's Echo
description: Cause a target's active affliction to echo in an adjacent healthy enemy. Deals 4d6 wyrd damage to the second target and copies the first target's active Seed. Cultivates as a Fester category spell.

agonyToll.description: Operational Friction: The psychic feedback echoes in the caster's mind, dealing 6 wyrd damage.

flavorText: The torment of one mind reflects in another. The scream sounds twice.

name: Pain Magnification
description: Magnify the pain of all active afflictions, forcing every infected enemy to immediately take 1 tick of all their active DoT damages. Cultivates as an Amplify category spell.

resourceCost.somaticText: Channel plaguebringer through gesture

damageConfig.formula: Immediate tick of all active DoTs

agonyToll.description: Virulence Surge: The cascade generates 5 Virulence.

flavorText: Every seed blooms in one terrifying, searing instant.

name: Essence Corruption
description: Corrupt the mana pool of an enemy spellcaster, dealing 5d8 wyrd damage and locking their mana regeneration for 1 round. Cultivates as a Torment category spell.

effects.name: Mana Lock
effects.description: Mana pool is corrupted and cannot regenerate mana or spend spell resources.

agonyToll.description: Operational Friction: The caster's own spiritual pathways choke; their mana regeneration is locked to 0 next turn.

flavorText: Your thoughts rot their wellspring. They reach for power, and find only ashes.

name: Affliction Mark
description: Mark an enemy with volatile contagion: Dodge -6 and Agility -4. If they die, the corpse bursts, applying Stage 0 Seeds to all enemies within 15ft. Cultivates as Fester.

resourceCost.somaticText: Channel plaguebringer through gesture

effects.name: Volatile Mark
effects.description: Dodge reduced by 6 and Agility by 4. Corpse will burst into seeds upon death.

agonyToll.description: Toll of Flesh: Tracing the volatile mark burns the caster's skin, dealing 6 blight damage.

flavorText: A wet, black seal painted on the forehead. The flies gather even before the target ceases breathing.

name: Plague Burst
description: Harvest all active afflictions in a 20ft radius (max 6), consuming each to deal 5d6 blight to its host and all adjacent targets. Cultivates as Weaken.

resourceCost.somaticText: Channel plaguebringer through gesture

agonyToll.description: Operational Friction: The violent physical recoil of the burst generates Virulence.

flavorText: Their flesh splits under internal pressure. The harvest is messy.

name: Mass Affliction
description: Unleash a wave of contagion that applies a Stage 0 Seed to all enemies within 30ft. Cultivates as a Fester category spell.

resourceCost.somaticText: Channel plaguebringer through gesture

effects.name: Rot Seeded
effects.description: Host carries a dormant plague seed.

agonyToll.description: Virulence Toll: The mass projection strains the caster's reserves, costing 8 Virulence.

flavorText: The gardener sows the seeds broadly. The soil is rich.

name: Pandemic
description: Force all active afflictions to immediately spread to up to 3 adjacent enemies in 15ft. Deals 4d8 blight damage to all targets in the cascade. Cultivates as a Fester category spell.

resourceCost.somaticText: Channel plaguebringer through gesture

agonyToll.description: Virulence Surge: The cascade generates 8 Virulence.

flavorText: One cough. Two stagger. Ten rot. The battlefield belongs to the garden.

name: Decay Field
description: Saturate a 30ft radius circle in creeping rot, dealing 5d8 blight damage per round for 4 rounds. Enemies inside have Dodge reduced by 5. Cultivates active afflictions as Decay.

resourceCost.somaticText: Channel plaguebringer through gesture

effects.name: Rotted Ground
effects.description: Slippery decay reduces Dodge by 5.

agonyToll.description: Operational Friction: The decay of the soil saps the caster's own speed, reducing movement speed by 10ft while the field persists.

flavorText: The earth rots beneath their feet. Nothing grows here anymore.

name: Garden's Wrath
description: Trigger every active affliction across all targets to deal its full DoT damage simultaneously in one devastating tick. Requires 3+ active afflictions. Cultivates as Amplify.

resourceCost.somaticText: Channel plaguebringer through gesture

damageConfig.formula: All affliction DoT sums � virulence multiplier

agonyToll.description: Operational Friction: The sheer neural load of detonating all active rot stuns the caster for 1 round.

flavorText: The garden blooms all at once. Every flower is a grave.

name: Mind Plague
description: Infect the minds of all enemies in 25ft: 8d8 wyrd, +2d8 per active affliction stage on them; those failing a Spirit save are confused 2 rounds. Cultivates as Torment.

resourceCost.somaticText: Channel plaguebringer through gesture

effects.name: Confused Mind
effects.description: Psychic rot induces severe disorientation, leading targets to attack allies or drop weapons.

agonyToll.description: Operational Friction: Projects extreme psychic instability, reducing the caster's Spirit by 4 for 2 rounds.

flavorText: The mind rots first. The body follows in trembling convulsions.

name: Plague Incarnate
description: Become a living vessel of disease for 5 rounds: weapon attacks apply random Stage 0 Seeds; enemies starting their turn within 15ft make a Con DC 16 save or contract a Seed. Cultivates as Torment.

resourceCost.somaticText: Channel plaguebringer through gesture

transformationConfig.description: Your form dissolves into a heavy, green-black fog, and insects hover inside your hollow chest cavity.

grantedAbilities.name: Plague Form
grantedAbilities.description: +5 Intelligence and +5 Constitution.

grantedAbilities.name: Plague Touch
grantedAbilities.description: Weapon attacks apply a random Stage 0 Seed.

grantedAbilities.name: Contagion Aura
grantedAbilities.description: Enemies within 15ft save (DC 16 Con) or contract Seed.

agonyToll.description: Virulence Toll: The transformation drains the caster's reserves, costing 12 Virulence for the duration.

flavorText: You are no longer merely a gardener tending the garden. You ARE the rot.

name: Epidemic
description: Start an epidemic chain: 8d6 blight to the primary, then chain to up to 8 enemies within 20ft, +2d6 per active affliction already on each target. Cultivates as Fester.

resourceCost.somaticText: Channel plaguebringer through gesture

agonyToll.description: Operational Friction: Unleashing the biological chains drains the caster, dealing 10 blight damage.

flavorText: One cough. Eight graves. The garden propagates.

name: Black Death
description: The ultimate plague. Targets below 30% HP with an active Stage 2+ affliction die instantly. Other targets with active afflictions take 12d10 blight damage. Cultivates as a Torment category spell.

resourceCost.somaticText: Channel plaguebringer through gesture

agonyToll.description: Toll of Flesh: The dark execute demands the caster's lifeblood, dealing 15 blight damage and imposing 1 level of exhaustion.

flavorText: The Black Death does not negotiate. It does not hesitate. It simply is the end of the garden.

name: Necrotic Eruption
description: Consume all active afflictions across all targets (max 8). Each consumed affliction explodes in a 30ft radius, dealing 4d8 blight damage (Stage 3 afflictions deal 6d8 instead). Cultivates as Decay.

resourceCost.somaticText: Channel plaguebringer through gesture

agonyToll.description: Toll of Flesh: The nuclear option causes severe cellular shock, generating Virulence.

flavorText: Every garden must eventually end. This one ends in fire and rotting blood.

name: Plague God
description: Ascend as the Plague God for 4 rounds: +8 Int, +8 Con, +6 Spirit; afflictions deal +50%; attacks apply random Stage 2 afflictions; Virulence locks at 100. Cultivates as Decay.

resourceCost.somaticText: Channel plaguebringer through gesture

transformationConfig.description: You grow to double your height, your body emanates a cloud of flies and decay-essence, and your eyes shine like dead stars.

grantedAbilities.name: Pestilence Enhancement
grantedAbilities.description: +8 Intelligence, +8 Constitution, and +6 Spirit.

grantedAbilities.name: Sol's Breath Plague
grantedAbilities.description: All active afflictions deal +50% damage.

grantedAbilities.name: Death Touch
grantedAbilities.description: Weapon attacks apply a random Stage 2 affliction.

grantedAbilities.name: Virulence Lock
grantedAbilities.description: Virulence is locked at 100 for the duration.

agonyToll.description: Tragic Finale: When the transformation ends, the caster's body collapses, taking 3d10 blight damage and gaining 2 levels of exhaustion.

flavorText: Mortal gardeners tend their plots. You tend the entire world, and the harvest is ripe.

name: Ultimate Affliction
description: Apply the ultimate plague: 15d10 blight now and 5d10 per round for 6 rounds; healing received -50% and all attributes -4. Requires 5+ active afflictions on the field. Cultivates as Amplify.

resourceCost.somaticText: Channel plaguebringer through gesture

effects.name: Ultimate Decay
effects.description: Healing received reduced by 50% and all attributes reduced by 4.

agonyToll.description: Virulence Toll: The ritual consumes 15 Virulence and leaves the caster weakened until a Greater Restoration.

flavorText: All five categories of biological ruin. One affliction. Total and absolute decay.

name: Incubation Period
description: All diseases have a 1-round delay before dealing damage or applying debuffs. Enemies can seek cures or kill you before the plague takes hold.

effects.name: Incubation Delay
effects.description: Permanent Disease Mechanic
effects.mechanicsText: All diseases suffer a 1-round delay before dealing damage or applying debuffs.

name: Sterile Environment
description: In cleansed areas (primal magic, healing, alchemical purification), diseases are suppressed. Cannot apply new diseases; existing ones stop dealing damage. Purity is your weakness.

effects.name: Purity Suppression
effects.description: In cleansed or consecrated areas
effects.mechanicsText: Diseases are suppressed: cannot apply new diseases, and existing diseases cease dealing damage.

name: Lavender Mask
description: Exhale a thick purple mist; harmless despite its look, it fills the room with lavender and blocks all scent-based tracking.

resourceCost.somaticText: Blow a long, slow breath through a copper pipe or closed fingers, a purple spark igniting

selectedEffects.name: Scent Siphon
selectedEffects.description: A 20-foot cloud blocks all scent-based tracking, scent perception, and covers the area in the scent of lavender for 10 minutes.

name: Rot-Touch
description: Lay a hand on dead organic matter (rope, leather, wood, a corpse) and accelerate decay: rope crumbles, leather splits, wood fails, corpses rot to bone. Living/magic materials resist. Out of combat.

resourceCost.somaticText: Press your palm to the matter and exhale the rot forward

selectedEffects.name: Accelerated Decay
selectedEffects.description: Rot one dead organic object to failure (rope crumbles, leather/softwood fails) or reduce a corpse to bone and sludge in minutes. Living tissue, cured/treated, and magical materials resist.
selectedEffects.mechanicsText: Rot one dead organic object to failure; speed-decay a corpse.

name: Mycelium-Web Sense
description: Press skin to earth and listen through the Ghost-Mycelium: feel every creature treading connected ground in range, and the sting of Wyrd-touch. Stone, deep water, dead earth break the web.

resourceCost.somaticText: Press palm and forehead to the earth and breathe with the rot

selectedEffects.name: Fungal Tremorsense
selectedEffects.description: For 10 minutes, sense creatures moving on connected earth/root within 120 ft  -  weight, direction, count, and whether Wyrd-touched. Stone, deep water, dead earth, and warded ground break the web.
selectedEffects.mechanicsText: Fungal tremorsense on connected ground, 120 ft, 10 min.

name: Plague-Reader
description: Taste blood, breath, or sweat, or touch a substance, and read the disease, poison, or affliction there: what it is, its cause, its progress, and whether it spreads. Out of combat.

resourceCost.somaticText: Touch the sample to tongue or skin and let your substrate answer

selectedEffects.name: Diagnosis
selectedEffects.description: Identify any disease/poison/affliction in a creature or substance: type, cause, progression, and contagiousness. Magical or engineered plagues may read faintly or partially.
selectedEffects.mechanicsText: Diagnose any disease/poison + cause/progression/contagion.

name: Counter-Culture
description: Culture a counter-strain to a diagnosed disease or poison from your own substrate, briefly hosting it to brew an antidote, neutralizing spore, or break-fever, then deliver the cure. Out of combat.

resourceCost.somaticText: Breed the counter-strain in your own blood, then draw it forth

selectedEffects.name: Cultured Antidote
selectedEffects.description: Neutralize one diagnosed disease or poison in a creature by culturing and delivering a counter-strain. You suffer a brief, mild bout of the counter-disease (disadvantage on one check within the next hour) as payment.
selectedEffects.mechanicsText: Cure one diagnosed disease/poison; you suffer a brief counter-symptom.

name: Cadaver-Puppet
description: Seed a fresh corpse with pestilence and raise it as a mindless servant for an hour: carries, springs traps, blocks doorways, distracts. It collapses when the rot runs dry. Out of combat.

resourceCost.somaticText: Exhale spores into the corpse's mouth and will it upright

selectedEffects.name: Macabre Servant
selectedEffects.description: Animate one fresh corpse as a shambling servant for 1 hour: carry, pull levers, spring traps ahead of the party, block a door, or distract. It cannot fight effectively and drops when the rot runs dry.
selectedEffects.mechanicsText: One corpse-servant for 1 hour; labor/trap-spring/distraction only.

name: Spore Scout
description: Exhale bioluminescent fungal spores that float up to 80ft ahead through passages or brush, returning tactile warnings of living creatures, hidden predators, or poisonous air. Out of combat.

resourceCost.somaticText: Blow a pinch of dried puffball dust into the air current

selectedEffects.name: Spore Reconnaissance
selectedEffects.description: Sense moving creatures and atmospheric toxicity within 80ft through drifting fungal filaments.
selectedEffects.mechanicsText: 80ft aerial spore reconnaissance; alerts to ambush/toxicity.

name: Miasma Veil
description: Release a low acrid mist in a 20ft radius: masks humanoid scent, dissolves fresh footprints into black mulch, and gives tracking predators disadvantage on Perception to follow. Out of combat.

resourceCost.somaticText: Crush moldy peat between your hands and scatter the spore-vapor

selectedEffects.name: Scent Erasure
selectedEffects.description: Erase tracks and scent for up to 6 creatures for 1 hour; imposes disadvantage on all tracking checks against the group.
selectedEffects.mechanicsText: Masks scent and tracks in 20ft radius for 1 hour.

name: Septic Shroud
description: Surround yourself in churning rot-fog for 3 rounds (15ft): enemies inside have disadvantage on attacks and cannot take reactions. The spores irritate your lungs, dealing 3 self-damage on cast.

resourceCost.somaticText: Exhale a dense green mist that swirls into a protective wall

effects.name: Septic Concealment
effects.description: Allies inside the shroud gain light concealment against ranged attacks.
effects.mechanicsText: Allies within 15ft gain light concealment against ranged attacks outside the cloud.

effects.name: Choking Miasma
effects.description: Hostile creatures within the shroud suffer disadvantage on attack rolls and lose reaction access.
effects.mechanicsText: Hostile creatures within 15ft have disadvantage on attack rolls and cannot use reactions.

agonyToll.description: Operational Friction: The toxic cloud inflames the caster's airways, dealing 3 direct self damage.

name: Parasitic Graft
description: Implant a feeding graft within 25ft. Enemy: siphon 50% of their healing for 3 rounds as temp HP. Ally: purge 1 non-blight condition, grant 15 temp HP, but 2 blight per turn.

resourceCost.somaticText: Flick a living fungal cyst directly into the target's open tissue

effects.name: Symbiotic Graft
effects.description: Allied target gains 15 temporary hit points and cleanses 1 condition, taking 2 blight damage per round.
effects.mechanicsText: Ally gains 15 Temp HP and cleanses 1 non-blight condition; suffers 2 blight damage each round.

effects.name: Parasitic Siphon
effects.description: Enemy target's healing received is reduced by 50%; intercepted healing transfers to the caster as temporary HP.
effects.mechanicsText: Enemy target receives -50% healing; intercepted healing converted into temporary HP for the caster.

agonyToll.description: Operational Friction: Splitting a portion of one's fungal host costs 20 Virulence.

name: Calcifying Rot
description: Infect a target's joints with petrifying spore growth: speed 0 on round 1, halved on rounds 2-3. Physical actions require a Con save or lose 1 AP to stiffened cartilage.

resourceCost.somaticText: Clench your fist until cartilage clicks in sympathy

effects.name: Calcified Joints
effects.description: Target speed is reduced to 0 for round 1, then halved for rounds 2-3.
effects.mechanicsText: Speed 0 on round 1, halved on rounds 2-3. Moving or physical attacks require DC 16 Constitution check or lose 1 AP.

effects.name: Stiffened Cartilage
effects.description: Attempting a physical action risks losing 1 AP to calcified joints.
effects.mechanicsText: DC 16 Constitution save or lose 1 AP on physical actions for 3 rounds.

agonyToll.description: Operational Friction: The caster's fingers stiffen in sympathetic reaction, giving -1 to weapon attacks for 1 round.

name: Bubonic Detonation
description: Detonate every dormant pustule in a 25ft radius: 6d8 blight to hostiles; targets suffering an affliction take double damage dice and are blinded 2 rounds.

resourceCost.somaticText: Violently thrust both hands outward, snapping bone needles between palms

effects.name: Septic Blindness
effects.description: Afflicted targets are blinded by spraying septic fluids for 2 rounds.
effects.mechanicsText: Targets with active blight or affliction are blinded for 2 rounds on failed Constitution save.

agonyToll.description: Operational Friction: The concussive biological rupture deals 6 self blight damage.

name: Spore-Hive Quarantine
description: Erect a 20ft bio-dome of fungal mycelium for 3 rounds: blocks line of sight and passage. Traversing the wall requires a DC 17 Con save or become silenced and blinded 1 round.

resourceCost.somaticText: Drive your staff or bare hand deep into the soil to awaken the spore ring

effects.name: Mycelial Quarantine Barrier
effects.description: Hemispherical mycelium wall (Hardness 10, 60 HP) blocks passage and line of sight. Passing through silences mucosal membranes.
effects.mechanicsText: Wall blocks physical and ranged passage (Hardness 10, 60 HP). Breaching creatures must pass DC 17 Con save or be silenced and blinded for 1 round.

selectedEffects.name: Zone Lockdown
selectedEffects.description: Quarantines the area, preventing airborne pathogens and gaseous substances from escaping or entering.
selectedEffects.mechanicsText: Seals the 20ft radius sphere against all airborne and gaseous vectors for 3 rounds.

agonyToll.description: Operational Friction: Feeding the quarantine dome drains 35 Virulence.

name: Chitinous Mycocarapace
description: Transmute your skin into layered fungal chitin for 3 rounds: DR 8 against physical and elemental damage, immunity to crits and bleed/poison, and melee attackers contract Stage 2 Wasting Sickness.

resourceCost.somaticText: Drag fingertips across cheeks and chest, splitting dermal layers into chitinous plates

effects.name: Chitinous Mycocarapace
effects.description: Gain DR 8, critical hit immunity, and affliction retaliatory infection against melee attackers.
effects.mechanicsText: Gain DR 8 against all physical/elemental damage, immunity to crits and poison/bleed. Melee attackers suffer Stage 2 Wasting Sickness.

agonyToll.description: Operational Friction: The calcified carapace restricts movement, reducing base movement speed by 10ft while active.

name: Symbiotic Re-Germination
description: Touch a creature that died within the last round: mycorrhizal threads knit organs and re-ignite nerves, reviving it at 25% max HP. For 1 hour: +2 Con, pain immunity, fungal marks.

resourceCost.somaticText: Press thumbs into the corpse's eyes and breathe virulent spores into their mouth

healingConfig.description: Restores a dead creature to life at 25% of their maximum HP.

effects.name: Mycorrhizal Sustenance
effects.description: +2 Constitution and immune to pain/fear for 1 hour.
effects.mechanicsText: +2 Constitution and immunity to pain, stun, and fear conditions for 1 hour.

selectedEffects.name: Spore Resuscitation
selectedEffects.description: Biological reanimation of a fallen creature within 1 round of death.
selectedEffects.mechanicsText: Brings a fallen ally back from death if cast within 1 round of their demise.

agonyToll.description: Operational Friction: The caster takes 15 necrotic/blight backlash damage as biological essence transfers.

name: World-Blight Cataclysm
description: Unleash the Bryngloom's rot-fissures across 40ft: cracks spew bile and spore gas for 8d10 blight, leaving mire that halves movement and infects survivors with Terminal Rot (3d10 blight at turn start).

resourceCost.somaticText: Slam both palms into the ground and crack open the crust with virulent rot

effects.name: Blight Mire
effects.description: Ground becomes corrosive septic mire, halving movement speed for 5 rounds.
effects.mechanicsText: Area is difficult terrain (speed halved). Any creature ending its turn in the mire takes 2d8 blight damage.

effects.name: Terminal Rot
effects.description: Survivors take 3d10 blight damage at start of turn until cured by sacred intervention.
effects.mechanicsText: Target suffers 3d10 blight damage at the start of each turn. Requires sacred purification or DC 18 Con save to end.

agonyToll.description: Operational Friction: The sheer cataclysm deals 10 self damage and exhausts the caster for 1 round.

name: Apotheosis of Rot
description: Become a living spore god for 1 minute: cannot drop below 1 HP; teleport between diseased/fungal entities within 120ft as a bonus action; enemies within 30ft advance 1 affliction stage, no save.

resourceCost.somaticText: Spread arms wide as fungal spores erupt from your chest and eyes into a towering halo

effects.name: Spore God Transcendence
effects.description: HP cannot drop below 1; free bonus-action teleport through infected targets up to 120ft.
effects.mechanicsText: Immune to death effects; damage cannot reduce HP below 1. Once per turn, teleport up to 120ft to any space adjacent to an afflicted creature (0 AP).

effects.name: Aura of Inevitable Rot
effects.description: All enemies within 30ft automatically advance 1 affliction stage at the end of each round.
effects.mechanicsText: All hostile creatures within 30ft automatically gain 1 affliction stage at the end of every round (no save).

agonyToll.description: Operational Friction: Once the apotheosis ends, the caster is stunned for 1 round as their biology settles.

name: Inferno Blast
description: Detonate a catastrophic sphere of volcanic ember fire in a 20 ft radius up to 60 ft away, dealing 4d6 ember damage and leaving burning ash ground.

effects.name: Burning Ash Ground
effects.description: The blast leaves burning ash ground that hazards creatures crossing it.

name: Hearth Heat
description: Radiate internal volcanic heat to warm your party in freezing blizzard conditions for 1 hour, granting immunity to environmental freezing damage.

selectedEffects.name: Volcanic Warmth
selectedEffects.description: Warm your party in freezing blizzard conditions for 1 hour, granting immunity to environmental freezing damage.
selectedEffects.mechanicsText: Party immune to environmental freezing, 1 hour.

name: Ember Spark
description: Scathrach gifts a malevolent spark compressed into a projectile. It burrows into flesh and ignites an unquenchable smolder: initial ember damage plus a burn consuming the target for 2 rounds.

resourceCost.somaticText: Snap fingers together, a malevolent red-orange spark forming and launching forward

name: Smoldering Touch
description: Your hand glows with Scathrach's contempt. Press it into flesh, searing through Durability and DR and leaving a smolder of 1d4 ember per round for 2 rounds. Not a spell; an imposition.

resourceCost.somaticText: Touch with glowing hand

name: Flicker
description: A quick flash of Scathrach's spite streaks out: small, precise, igniting instantly and trailing heat. The horror flicking a match; dismissive, casual, enough to set the world alight.

name: Cooling Ember
description: Press a hand to your chest and will the furnace to dim. Scathrach screams; the heat draws back, soothing your corrupted flesh and restoring some health. The Mana Tax costs mana you cannot afford.

resourceCost.somaticText: Place hand over heart

name: Heat Shield
description: Pull Scathrach's heat outward into a superheated barrier; attacks passing through are warped and dissipated by thermal distortion. A fragment of the horror's own defenses, borrowed.

resourceCost.somaticText: Raise hands to create barrier

effects.name: Heat Shield
effects.description: +2 Damage Reduction for 2 rounds. The heat shield absorbs and disperses incoming attacks, reducing the damage that reaches you.

name: Scorching Grasp
description: Flames engulf your hand. Seize the enemy: fire clings, searing through Durability and DR for 2d8 + INT/2 ember, then burning 1d4 per round for 2 rounds. The mark says: property of the Ashen Sovereign.

resourceCost.somaticText: Grasp with burning hand

name: Flame Lash
description: A whip of condensed fire lashes from your palm, coiling an enemy and dragging them toward you. The flames sear as they grip; they feel Scathrach's hunger pulling them close.

resourceCost.somaticText: Whip hand forward

effects.name: Pull
effects.description: Pulls the target 15 feet toward the caster. DC 14 strength check negates.

name: Cinder Bolt
description: Compress Scathrach's hatred into a bolt of cinders and hurl it. On impact it detonates, showering the area in sparks and slag. A small explosion by Pyrofiend standards; a catastrophe by anyone else's.

resourceCost.somaticText: Hurl cinder bolt

name: Fireball
description: A sphere of condensed Wyrd-fire streaks to a chosen point and detonates, engulfing all within range. The spell that earned the Pyrofiend its reputation; and its body count.

resourceCost.somaticText: Hurl ball of flame

name: Burning Hands
description: Spread your fingers and Scathrach exhales through your palms: a cone of Wyrd-fire scorches a 20-foot arc. Close-range devastation for when the enemy is too close; exactly when Scathrach is happiest.

resourceCost.somaticText: Spread fingers wide

name: Flame Step
description: Step through a tear carved by Scathrach's fire: vanish in flame and reappear nearby, leaving fire at both departure and arrival. Not graceful; violent, disorienting, smelling of burnt air.

name: Infernal Blast
description: A concentrated blast of Scathrach's purest hatred sears through defenses: 5d6 + INT ember. At Inferno Level 4+ the corruption surges for an extra 2d6. Not fire; annihilation wearing fire as a mask.

resourceCost.somaticText: Thrust palm forward

name: Searing Chains
description: Burning chains lash between enemies for 3d6 + INT ember, tethering them. Jumps deal 75% and ignite for 1d6 ember/round for 2 rounds, leaping to 3 more within 15ft. They bind as they burn.

resourceCost.somaticText: Whip arm forward, chains of fire erupt

name: Fiery Aura
description: Open the furnace door: an aura of contempt deals 2d6 ember to any enemy within 5ft. Persists up to 3 rounds while you concentrate; a pulsing reminder that you are not safe to stand near.

resourceCost.somaticText: Spread arms wide

damageConfig.triggerDescription: Enemies within 5 feet take 2d6 ember damage at the start of each of their turns

name: Pressure Vent
description: Vent 3 Inferno Veil in a violent rupture: take 1d6 self-damage, then move 20 feet without provoking opportunity attacks, leaving a smoke shroud that grants concealment until your next turn.

resourceCost.somaticText: Clap both palms over your forearm vents and blow the furnace out

selectedEffects.name: Exhaust Burst
selectedEffects.description: Vent 3 Inferno Veil, take 1d6 self-damage, and move up to 20 feet without provoking opportunity attacks.
selectedEffects.mechanicsText: Vent 3 Veil; 1d6 self; 20 ft free move.

selectedEffects.name: Trailing Shroud
selectedEffects.description: Leave a 5-foot smoke cloud at your origin that grants you concealment until the start of your next turn.
selectedEffects.mechanicsText: Concealment until start of next turn.

name: Slag Bulwark
description: Molten slag hardens over your body. Gain a shield equal to 10 + 3 per Inferno Veil level for 3 rounds; melee attackers take 1d6 ember damage. Casting it raises Veil by 1.

resourceCost.somaticText: Pour slag down your arms and let it set

effects.name: Slag Bulwark
effects.description: Absorbs 10 + 3 per Inferno Veil level damage until depleted, or until 3 rounds pass.
effects.mechanicsText: Shield 10 + 3xVeil; expires after 3 rounds.

effects.name: Molten Backlash
effects.description: A melee attacker that strikes the shield takes 1d6 ember damage.
effects.mechanicsText: Retaliation: 1d6 ember to melee attackers.

name: Hellfire Wave
description: Scathrach opens its mouth through yours: a 30ft cone of hellfire for 8d6 + INT ember. Those caught are Cinder-Marked for 2 rounds (+1d6 ember, no stealth). They do not burn. They cease.

resourceCost.somaticText: Sweep arms forward

effects.name: Cinder-Marked
effects.description: Marked by Scathrach for 2 rounds: takes +1d6 ember damage from each of your ember spells, and cannot benefit from stealth or invisibility.
effects.mechanicsText: Marked 2 rounds: +1d6 ember per ember spell; stealth/invisibility denied.

name: Immolation
description: Designate a target for Scathrach's obsession: 6d8 + INT/2 ember now, then 1d6 + INT/4 per round for 3 rounds. It screams; Scathrach hums; you try not to think what that says about you.

resourceCost.somaticText: Clench fist

name: Fire Whip
description: A whip of infernal fury; the idea of fire made violent. It strikes for 7d6 + INT ember and may stun as Scathrach's malice overwhelms the nerves. The horror's tongue tastes what it strikes.

resourceCost.somaticText: Crack whip motion

name: Smothering Cloud
description: Conjure a 20-foot radius cloud of scalding ash-smoke within 50 feet for 3 rounds. Enemies inside are blinded (DC 14 Constitution save negates); you and your allies see through it and are unaffected.

resourceCost.somaticText: Exhale a rolling wall of ash-smoke

effects.name: Blinded
effects.description: Enemies inside the cloud are blinded: disadvantage on attack rolls and they cannot make opportunity attacks. You and your allies ignore the cloud.

name: Slagfall Field
description: Blanket a 15-foot radius within 60 feet in gripping molten slag for 3 rounds: difficult terrain, and creatures entering it make a DC 15 Strength save or are restrained until the end of their turn.

resourceCost.somaticText: Drag a fistful of slag across the ground

effects.name: Gripped by Slag
effects.description: Creatures entering the field or starting their turn there make a DC 15 Strength save or are restrained until the end of their turn. The field is difficult terrain.

name: Lava Burst
description: Slam your fists down and Scathrach boils the earth: a 15ft lava burst for 9d6 + INT ember; the crater stays molten 2 rounds (1d6 at turn start). At Inferno Level 7+ it deepens to 16d6 + INT×2.

resourceCost.somaticText: Slam fist downward

name: Flame Storm
description: Raise your arms and Scathrach screams skyward: a firestorm descends on a 20ft radius for 8d6 + INT ember, then 2d6 + INT/2 per round for 3 rounds. The horror's rage made manifest.

resourceCost.somaticText: Raise arms and swirl

name: Infernal Brand (Advanced)
description: Carve Scathrach's sigil into an enemy: 4d6 + INT/3 ember now, then 2d6 + INT/2 per round for 4 rounds. It saps their strength as Scathrach feeds through the mark. Branded for the furnace.

resourceCost.somaticText: Draw burning sigil

effects.name: Weakened
effects.description: The target's physical power is diminished by the searing heat, making them weaker and less effective in combat. The infernal brand saps their strength as it burns.

name: Heat-Sight
description: Read the thermal signature of everything within 60 feet for 3 rounds. You see invisible and hidden creatures, see through smoke and fog, and gain advantage on Perception checks against living targets.

resourceCost.somaticText: Press two fingers to your temples and let the heat in

selectedEffects.name: Thermal Vision
selectedEffects.description: For 3 rounds you perceive heat signatures: invisible and hidden creatures within 60 feet are revealed to you, smoke and fog do not obscure your sight, and you have advantage on Perception checks against living targets.
selectedEffects.mechanicsText: Reveal invisible/hidden 60 ft; see through smoke/fog; advantage on Perception vs living; 3 rounds.

name: Volcanic Eruption
description: Command the earth to open: a 25ft eruption of magma and ash for 12d6 + INT×2 ember (DC 16 Agility half). At Inferno Level 7+ it deepens to 16d6 + INT×2. Only shapes remain in the slag.

resourceCost.somaticText: Slam both hands down

name: Hellfire Breath
description: Inhale, and Scathrach exhales through you: a 40ft cone of hellfire for 10d6 + INT×2 ember. Not a spell; regurgitation. Anything caught was always on fire; it simply did not know until now.

resourceCost.somaticText: Inhale deeply and exhale

name: Ember Empowerment
description: Open yourself to Scathrach for 5 rounds: +5 ember damage on ember attacks; enemies within 5ft take 1d6 ember from round 3; your ember resistance doubles at round 5. Interest is your soul.

resourceCost.somaticText: Clench fists and channel

effects.name: Ember Damage Boost
effects.description: Ember damage increased by +5 for 5 rounds. All fire-based attacks deal additional damage as Wyrd-power flows through your spells and abilities.

stages.description: Wyrd-power intensifies, enemies within 5 ft take 1d6 ember

stages.effect: +5 Ember Damage + Burning Aura + Inferno Resistance
stages.description: Full Wyrd-empowerment, ember damage taken reduced by 50%

name: Whisper Bridle
description: Seize the Whisper's leash for 3 rounds: advantage on Spirit saves against it, and your ember area spells can exclude up to 3 allies. Casting it raises Veil by 2.

resourceCost.somaticText: Wrap a burning chain around your own throat and pull it taut

effects.name: Bridled Whisper
effects.description: Advantage on Spirit saving throws against the Wyrd-touched Whisper; reroll the first failed Whisper save each round.
effects.mechanicsText: Advantage vs Whisper; one reroll per round.

effects.name: Controlled Burn
effects.description: Your ember area spells can exclude up to 3 allies of your choice from their effects.
effects.mechanicsText: Exclude up to 3 allies from your ember AoE spells.

name: Meteor Shower
description: Reach into Scathrach's furnace and pull down the sky: meteors descend on a 30ft radius for 14d6 + INT×2 ember. The ground craters, the air ignites; a natural disaster at your epicenter.

resourceCost.somaticText: Raise arms to the sky

name: Infernal Nova
description: You detonate. A sphere of infernal fire expands 35ft for 14d6 + INT×2 ember; take 2d6 self-damage and struck foes are Staggered (disadvantage on attacks/saves) until their next turn ends.

resourceCost.somaticText: Spread arms wide and explode

effects.name: Staggered
effects.description: The concussive blast staggers the target: disadvantage on attack rolls and saving throws until the end of its next turn.
effects.mechanicsText: Disadvantage on attacks and saves until end of next turn.

name: Phoenix Flame
description: Summon a phoenix's ghost; or Scathrach lets you believe so. A 25ft detonation deals 12d6 + INT×2 ember, then the ground burns 3d6 + INT/2 per round for 4 rounds. A funeral pyre; whose is unclear.

resourceCost.somaticText: Summon phoenix gesture

name: Obsidian Aegis
description: Raise a 15-foot radius obsidian heat-dome for 3 rounds. You and allies inside gain +3 DR and take half damage from rime sources; your own rime vulnerability is suppressed while you stand within it.

resourceCost.somaticText: Slam a fist down; black glass erupts in a dome

effects.name: Obsidian Aegis
effects.description: Allies within 15 feet gain +3 DR while the dome holds.
effects.mechanicsText: +3 DR to allies inside the 15 ft dome.

effects.name: Rimeward
effects.description: Allies within 15 feet take half damage from rime sources; the Pyrofiend's own rime vulnerability is suppressed while inside.
effects.mechanicsText: Rime damage halved inside; Pyrofiend rime vulnerability suppressed.

name: Ember Siphon
description: Devour lingering flame: end ember over-time effects on allies within 30 feet, extinguish one fire zone, and give one ally +2d6 ember on their next attack within 2 rounds. Vents 1 Veil.

resourceCost.somaticText: Inhale the smoke off your allies and swallow it

selectedEffects.name: Consume the Flame
selectedEffects.description: End all burning and ember over-time effects on allies within 30 feet, and extinguish one non-magical fire or ember hazard zone within range.
selectedEffects.mechanicsText: Cleanse ember over-time effects on allies in 30 ft; extinguish one fire zone.

effects.name: Siphoned Heat
effects.description: One ally of your choice gains +2d6 ember damage on their next attack within 2 rounds.
effects.mechanicsText: Ally's next attack deals +2d6 ember; expires after 2 rounds.

name: Infernal Avatar
description: For 10 rounds become an Infernal Avatar: +5 ember spell power, +3 DR, ember immunity, 10ft burning aura (2d6 ember). Skin and voice gone; only fire remains. When it ends, you feel every second.

resourceCost.somaticText: Spread arms wide

transformationConfig.formDescription: You become a being of pure Wyrd-fire, wreathed in flames and radiating intense heat.

specialAbilities.name: Burning Aura
specialAbilities.description: Enemies within 10 feet take 2d6 ember damage at the start of their turn

name: Apocalypse
description: Scathrach's grandest gift and cruelest joke: a 40ft cataclysm for 16d10 + INT×2 ember. At maximum Inferno Level, damage dice explode on max rolls. The blast radius is a grave; the silence is applause.

resourceCost.somaticText: Raise arms and channel all power

name: Hellfire Ritual
description: A ritual not to summon Scathrach but to open the floodgates wider: for 3 rounds your ember damage surges +10, and by round 3 your Inferno Level bonuses double. Borrowing against your own annihilation.

resourceCost.somaticText: Perform ritual gestures

effects.name: Massive Fire Boost
effects.description: +10 ember Spell Power for 3 rounds. A ritual of infernal power dramatically surges through your fire magic.

stages.description: Infernal ritual begins, fire magic surges
Wyrd-flames radiate outward, enemies within 10 ft take 2d6 ember per round

stages.effect: +10 ember Spell Power + Burning Aura + Inferno Amplification
stages.description: Ritual climax, all inferno level bonuses doubled for the final round

name: Veil Rupture
description: Spend 4 Inferno Veil to rupture your pressure seal: enemies within 30 feet are pushed 20 feet and knocked prone (DC 16 Strength save negates prone); allies gain +10 feet speed for 2 rounds.

resourceCost.somaticText: Drive a thumb into the seam of your own sternum and split it

effects.name: Veil Shockwave
effects.description: Enemies within 30 feet are pushed 20 feet away from you; a DC 16 Strength save negates only the knockdown.

effects.name: Vented Momentum
effects.description: Allies within 30 feet gain +10 feet movement speed for 2 rounds.
effects.mechanicsText: +10 ft speed to allies in 30 ft for 2 rounds.

name: Brimstone Teleport
description: Tear reality and step through Scathrach's furnace, reappearing up to 60ft away in hellfire dealing 6d6 + INT×2 ember within 10ft of arrival. Not travel; passing through the horror's maw.

selectedEffects.name: Brimstone Teleport
selectedEffects.description: Teleport up to 60 feet through hellfire, appearing in a burst of flames.

name: Cinder Ascension
description: Surrender completely: +15 ember damage, +5 DR, ember immunity, 30ft flight, 3d6 ember to foes within 15ft each turn. Requires Inferno 9; drop below 9 in 3 turns or Scathrach claims you forever.

resourceCost.somaticText: Channel ultimate power

effects.name: Cinder Ascension
effects.description: +15 ember damage to all spells, +5 DR, ember damage immunity, flight (30 ft), and enemies within 15 feet take 3d6 ember damage at start of their turn. Requires Inferno Level 9. Death clock still ticks.

effects.name: Ashen Carapace
effects.description: +5 DR from Wyrd-touched carapace

effects.name: Fire Mastery
effects.description: +15 ember spell power

name: Inferno Mastery
description: Scathrach's hunger through your ruined body: a 50ft inferno for 20d10 + INT×2 ember. At Inferno 7+ it deepens to 22d10; at 9, 25d10 + INT×3. The world burns; you burn; the distinction is meaningless.

resourceCost.somaticText: Command all fire

name: Ashen Crucible
description: Seal your Veil in a crucible of will for 3 rounds: it cannot ascend, the Level 9 death clock pauses, and you gain +3 DR. When it ends, take 2d6 self-damage and vent 2 Veil.

resourceCost.somaticText: Cup your hands over your heart and seal the furnace shut

effects.name: Sealed Veil
effects.description: For 3 rounds your Inferno Veil cannot ascend and the Level 9 death clock pauses; you gain +3 DR. When the crucible ends, take 2d6 self-damage and vent 2 Veil.
effects.mechanicsText: Veil cannot rise; death clock paused; +3 DR; end: 2d6 self and vent 2.

name: Burnout
description: When nothing burns; no ignited targets, no Inferno Level, no auras; the furnace sputters: -2 spell attack rolls, -1d6 fire damage. Set something ablaze. Lifts when a fire spell deals damage.

effects.name: Furnace Sputter
effects.description: When no fires or auras are active
effects.mechanicsText: -2 spell attack rolls and -1d6 fire damage until a fire spell deals damage.

name: Fire Dependency
description: Your furnace runs so hot that rime is catastrophic: +50% cold/frost damage taken; taking rime raises Inferno Veil +1; in water or cold your Inferno Level falls 2 per round. Water is antithetical.

effects.name: Rime Catastrophe
effects.description: Permanent Vulnerability
effects.mechanicsText: Gain +50% vulnerability to cold/frost (rime) damage. Taking rime raises Inferno Veil +1.

effects.name: Water Antithesis
effects.description: Environmental Decay
effects.mechanicsText: In water or extreme cold, your Inferno Level falls 2 per round.

name: Heat Signature
description: You always radiate heat: no Stealth or invisibility; enemies have advantage on Perception within 60ft; ice melts within 10ft; water deals 1d6 per round of immersion. Never hidden, never safe.

effects.name: Living Beacon
effects.description: Never Hidden
effects.mechanicsText: Cannot benefit from Stealth or invisibility. Enemies within 60 ft gain advantage on Perception checks.

effects.name: Thermal Radiance & Quench
effects.description: Environmental Reaction
effects.mechanicsText: Ice melts within 10 ft. Water immersion deals 1d6 damage per round.

name: Living Hearth
description: Bank your inner fire to a gentle glow: radiate warmth and ember-light (30ft), staving off cold exposure and frostbite for nearby allies, and kindle fires from your palm. 1 HP/hour. Out of combat.

resourceCost.somaticText: Cup the ember in your palms and breathe it down to a glow

selectedEffects.name: Banked Fire
selectedEffects.description: For 1 hour: emit safe warmth + ember-light in 30 ft; allies ignore mundane cold exposure/frostbite; kindle fires. Costs 1 HP/hour.
selectedEffects.mechanicsText: Warmth + light 30 ft; ignore cold exposure; 1 HP/hour.

effects.name: Living Hearth
effects.description: You radiate safe warmth and soft ember-light: allies within 30ft ignore mundane cold exposure and frostbite.
effects.mechanicsText: Allies ignore cold exposure within 30ft; 1 HP/hour.

name: Smelter's Touch
description: Focus your heat to a surgical point: smelt, weld, solder, or cut metal; seal a crack, fuse pieces, repair a mechanism. The Pyrofiend as smith; take 1d4 self-damage from back-heat. Out of combat.

resourceCost.somaticText: Pinch the heat to a needle-fine point at your fingertips

selectedEffects.name: Surgical Heat
selectedEffects.description: Smelt/weld/solder/cut one metal object: repair a mechanism, seal a crack, fuse metals, or slice a bar. Precise, not destructive. Take 1d4 self-damage from back-heat. Enchanted metal resists.
selectedEffects.mechanicsText: Precisely weld/cut/repair one metal object; 1d4 self-damage.

name: Ash-Reading
description: Burn an object and read the Sovereign's memory in the ash: what it was, how it died, who last held it; or ask Scathrach one question answered in the smoke. Never kind; costs 1d4 wyrd. Out of combat.

resourceCost.somaticText: Crumble the object to ash and inhale the question off the smoke

selectedEffects.name: Sovereign's Memory
selectedEffects.description: From the ash of a burned object: learn what it was, how it was destroyed, who last held it  -  OR ask Scathrach one question answered in the smoke (truthful, unkind, partial). Costs 1d4 wyrd self-damage (sanity).
selectedEffects.mechanicsText: Read an object's end-memory or ask Scathrach 1 question; 1d4 wyrd.

name: Cauterize
description: Grip a wound and burn it shut: stop bleeding, sear a gash, or neutralize contact poison; field surgery trading agony for survival. No HP restored; bleed/poison stops. Out of combat.

resourceCost.somaticText: Press a burning palm over the wound and hold

selectedEffects.name: Burned Shut
selectedEffects.description: Stop active bleeding, stabilize a dying creature, or neutralize a contact/ingested poison by burning the wound. Restores no HP; deals 1d6 self-damage to the caster (sympathetic heat) and leaves a scar.
selectedEffects.mechanicsText: Stop bleed/stabilize/neutralize contact poison; no HP heal; 1d6 self.

name: Cinder-Veil
description: Bend heat off your skin into a mirage that distorts your party's outlines: advantage on Stealth and hidden position from distant observers in hot, dry, or smoky places. Useless in cold, wet, wind.

resourceCost.somaticText: Exhale a flat sheet of rippling heat across your party

selectedEffects.name: Heat Mirage
selectedEffects.description: For 10 minutes, you and allies within 20 ft gain advantage on Stealth and obscure your exact count/position from distant observers  -  but only in hot, dry, or smoky conditions. Cold, wet, or wind dissolves the mirage instantly.
selectedEffects.mechanicsText: Advantage Stealth + obscure position; hot/dry/smoky only, 10 min.

effects.name: Heat Mirage
effects.description: You and allies within 20ft gain advantage on Stealth and obscure your position from distant observers.
effects.mechanicsText: Advantage Stealth; hot/dry/smoky only; 10 minutes.

name: Kinetic Discharge
description: Vent stored AEP into a 20ft frontal cone of compressed kinetic force, dealing storm damage and knocking enemies back 15ft.

effects.name: Kinetic Knockback
effects.description: Enemies in the cone are knocked back 15ft.

name: Null Field Bastion
description: Create a 10ft anti-magic zone around yourself. Allies inside gain +4 to saves against spells and 50% spell damage reduction for 2 rounds.

effects.name: Null Field
effects.description: Allies inside gain +4 to saves against spells and 50% spell damage reduction for 2 rounds.
effects.mechanicsText: +4 saves vs spells; 50% spell damage reduction, 2 rounds.

name: Radiation Quench
description: Vent dangerous Silence Resonance from your plating, purging all debuffs from yourself and dealing heavy storm damage to all adjacent enemies.

name: Prismatic Mirror Bastion
description: Reflect a targeted hostile spell back at the caster, dealing full spell damage plus storm backlash to the attacking mage.

name: Anti-Magic Shackle
description: Clamp cold-iron leyline cuffs onto an enemy within 30ft. The target is Silenced and cannot cast spells or use magical abilities for 2 rounds.

effects.name: Leyline Cuffs
effects.description: The target is silenced and cannot cast spells or use magical abilities.

effects.name: Magical Lockout
effects.description: Spells and magical abilities are disabled for 2 rounds.
effects.mechanicsText: Magical ability lockout, 2 rounds.

name: Overload Shockwave
description: Detonate 50 stored AEP into a 30ft kinetic shockwave. Deals heavy storm damage and knocks all enemies prone.

effects.name: Knocked Prone
effects.description: All enemies in the 30ft blast are knocked prone.

name: Fortress of Nullification
description: Anchor into the earth. Become immune to all magical damage, forced movement, and crowd control for 2 rounds, absorbing all spells in 20ft.

effects.name: Anchored Fortress
effects.description: Immune to all magical damage, forced movement, and crowd control for 2 rounds; absorbs all spells within 20ft.
effects.mechanicsText: Magical damage/forced movement/CC immunity; absorbs spells within 20ft, 2 rounds.

name: Leyline Devourer Nova
description: Devour all magical energy in a 40ft radius. Strips all enemy buffs, drains enemy spellcasters of mana, and deals massive arcane damage.

name: Singularity Aegis
description: Form an anti-magic black hole in your fortress shield for 3 rounds. Swallows all hostile projectiles and reflects 100% of absorbed spell damage to enemies.

effects.name: Singularity Aegis
effects.description: Swallows all hostile projectiles and reflects 100% of absorbed spell damage back at enemies for 3 rounds.
effects.mechanicsText: Absorb projectiles; reflect 100% absorbed spell damage, 3 rounds.

name: Aegis Ward
description: Instantly raise a prismatic barrier granting +3 Passive DR against an incoming strike.

effects.name: Prismatic Barrier
effects.description: Grants +3 Passive DR against the incoming strike.
effects.mechanicsText: +3 Passive DR.

name: Spell Break
description: Interrupt an enemy casting a spell within 30 ft by detonating a ward charge, forcing the spell to fail.

effects.name: Spell Broken
effects.description: The spell fails and is countered at its source.

name: Arcane Radiation
description: Absorbed magic is radioactive poison: at your turn's end, unspent AEP deals blight equal to (AEP / 10, rounded down) and reduces max HP by the same until a long rest.

effects.name: AEP Radiation Burn
effects.description: Toxic Unspent Magic
effects.mechanicsText: At the end of your turn, unspent AEP deals blight damage equal to floor(AEP / 10) and reduces maximum HP by the same amount until a long rest.

name: Brittle Kinetic Shell
description: Your silence-glass plating is hyper-specialized for absorbing energy, leaving you catastrophically vulnerable to martial trauma: permanent +50% vulnerability to all smashing and slicing damage.

effects.name: Martial Trauma Vulnerability
effects.description: +50% Vulnerability
effects.mechanicsText: Permanent +50% damage taken from all smashing and slicing (physical) attacks.

name: Silence Siphon
description: A brutal melee strike that rips raw magic from the target: 1d8 physical and 1d8 storm. A spellcaster also loses 2d4 mana. Generates +15 AEP as the raw magic enters your blood.

resourceCost.somaticText: Channel spellguard through gesture

selectedEffects.name: Mana Tear

effects.mechanicsText: +6 DR and death prevention inside sepulcher.
