triggers.action: Spends 7 benediction to summon the Archive's stasis.

somaticText: Thrust your ceremonial sickle into the stone, dragging up pillars of blue glacial ice.
verbalText: Siste in glacie — stand upright in the ice and witness.

name: Sovereign Haruspex Transformation
description: Ascend as sovereign of blood and fate: skin hardens into an ivory bone carapace, veins glow blinding gold. You write the dice, rewrite the marrow, and decide who lives.

effects.name: Sovereign Haruspex
effects.description: You control all omens. Declare d20 Even/Odd before any roll. Spend 1 resource to change any result by �1. All allies gain +2 to all rolls, all enemies suffer -2 to all rolls.
effects.mechanicsText: Declare d20 outcomes, modify rolls by �1, allies +2, enemies -2.

selectedEffects.name: Omnipotent Reading
selectedEffects.description: Declare d20 Even/Odd outcomes before rolls. Spend Benediction/Malediction to modify rolls.
selectedEffects.mechanicsText: Modify rolls by �1 per resource spent.

triggers.name: Fate's Toll
triggers.action: Spends 0 fate to bend fate.

somaticText: Snap your wrist to release the gathered omen as a lance of fated heat.
verbalText: Utter the decree that condemns the target to its foretold end.

name: Harbinger of the Black Ash
description: Dissolve your mortal frame into a walking storm of decaying black ash and screaming wyrd horror. Every enemy who looks upon you staggers as skin turns to soot and femurs crack under fated weight.

effects.name: Screaming Ash
effects.description: Enemies have -3 to all d20 rolls, and you can force one reroll of an enemy success per round.
effects.mechanicsText: -3 to all rolls for enemies. Force one success reroll per round.

triggers.name: Fate's Toll
triggers.action: Spends 15 malediction to bend fate.

somaticText: Press two fingers to your brow and draw the pattern of what will be.
verbalText: Whisper the reading aloud so the world is bound to it.

name: Hierophant of Blinding Radiance
description: Burn away your humanity, becoming a towering cathedral of white-hot radiant splinters. The battlefield is consecrated in golden light: allies are healed and blessed with legendary fortune.

effects.name: Unending Splendor
effects.description: Allies gain +3 to all d20 rolls, absolute resistance to all damage types, and immunity to frightened/charmed. Grant one free reroll on a failed roll per round.
effects.mechanicsText: +3 all rolls, all damage resistance, immune to frightened/charmed. Grant one reroll per round.

triggers.name: Fate's Toll
triggers.action: Spends 15 benediction to bend fate.

somaticText: Snap your wrist to release the gathered omen as a lance of fated heat.
verbalText: Utter the decree that condemns the target to its foretold end.

name: Echo of the First Failing
description: Release the vision of the First Failing: enemies within 50ft take 10d8 wyrd, blinded and slowed 3 rounds (DC 19 Spirit halves, negates blindness). Generates 5 Benediction and 5 Malediction.

effects.name: Cosmic Blindness
effects.description: Blinded and slowed for 3 rounds by the terror of the dying star.
effects.mechanicsText: Blinded and speed halved for 3 rounds (DC 19 Spirit save negates).

triggers.name: Cataclysmic Surge
triggers.action: Generates 5 benediction and 5 malediction from the cosmic vision.

somaticText: Tear open your palms and look upward into the sky that will one day go black.
verbalText: Sol moritur, et nos videmus — the sun dies, and we see it all.

name: Whisper of the Harvester
description: Stare at a recently deceased beast or humanoid, reading the fading thermal residue of their final steps; trace a glowing copper line mapping where their companions fled.

resourceCost.somaticText: Trace your finger through the damp soil near the target, ignoring the copper smell of rot

selectedEffects.name: Thermal Trace
selectedEffects.description: Reveals a glowing trail showing the route taken by up to three of the deceased target's companions within the last hour.

somaticText: Press two fingers to your brow and draw the pattern of what will be.
verbalText: Whisper the reading aloud so the world is bound to it.

name: Cast the Bones
description: Scatter rune-scored bones and read the fall. Ask one question about a near-future event (within a day) for a truthful omen; yes, no, ill, or favorable; plus one cryptic image. Out of combat.

selectedEffects.name: Bone Omen
selectedEffects.description: One yes/no/ill/favorable answer to a near-future (within 1 day) question, plus a single cryptic image. The bones answer the likeliest probability, not destiny � and they are terse.
selectedEffects.mechanicsText: 1 near-future yes/no + a cryptic image.

somaticText: Cast the bone-set on bare ground; the scatter is the sentence.
verbalText: The question, once � the bones answer what is asked, not what is meant.

name: Read the Entrails
description: Read a fresh corpse's viscera: what killed it, what it feared last, what it carried, and whether greater danger lies where it came from. No corpse? Pay the Blood Price (1d6 slicing + Bleed).

selectedEffects.name: Visceral Reading
selectedEffects.description: From a fresh corpse learn: cause of death, its last fear, recent stomach/contents, and whether greater danger lies back along its trail. No fresh corpse: pay 1d6 slicing + Bleed to read your own viscera for a lesser reading.
selectedEffects.mechanicsText: Read a fresh corpse's last moments + danger on its trail.

somaticText: Hook the blade beneath the ribs and let the heat speak before it cools.
verbalText: A low, droning tone � the entrails will not read themselves in silence.

name: Smoke-Sign Reading
description: Burn a token of your quarry (hair, cloth, a name) and read the smoke: it streams toward the target's location, thick when close, thin when far, tracking across any distance. Out of combat.

selectedEffects.name: Smoke Trail
selectedEffects.description: For 1 hour the smoke from a burned token of the target streams toward its current location � thickening as you near, thinning as you move away. Works across any distance; defeated by wards that block divination, not by distance.
selectedEffects.mechanicsText: Track one person/place/object by smoke for 1 hour.

somaticText: Feed the token to the flame and watch which way the ash leans.
verbalText: Name the quarry in the old counting-tongue; the smoke listens.

name: Omen of the Threshold
description: Before a door, pass, or chosen path, slit your palm and read the crossing's immediate future: ambushers, traps, who waits beyond, the first blow struck. Visions fade past sixty seconds. Out of combat.

selectedEffects.name: Sixty-Second Glimpse
selectedEffects.description: Glimpse the next 60 seconds of what occurs if you cross the threshold now � threats, waiting foes, the first attack. Shows the likeliest immediate future only; changes if you delay or alter approach.
selectedEffects.mechanicsText: Preview next 60 seconds past a threshold.

somaticText: Press a bleeding palm to the doorframe and breathe until the room ahead bleeds into view.
verbalText: A counted whisper � one, two, three � the future arrives on the third.

name: Doom-Seer's Mark
description: Study a creature within sight and read the omens on its body: learn its single greatest near-future fear or vulnerability and sense whether it intends betrayal within the next hour. Out of combat.

selectedEffects.name: Read the Marked
selectedEffects.description: Learn one creature's greatest near-future fear/vulnerability and whether it intends you betrayal within the hour. Surface omens only � not deep secrets or long plans.
selectedEffects.mechanicsText: Read one creature's top fear + betrayal intent.

somaticText: Lidless stare at the target until the fate-lines surface on their skin.
verbalText: Silence � the reading is done with the eyes, not the mouth.

name: Sanctified Hearth
description: Consecrate a 20ft campsite with starlight runes. Prevents nighttime ambushes, alerts the party to approaching threats, and allows restful sleep. Out of combat.

selectedEffects.name: Consecrated Camp
selectedEffects.description: Starlight runes consecrate a 20ft campsite: no nighttime ambushes, alerts the party to approaching threats, and allows restful sleep.
selectedEffects.mechanicsText: Warded camp: no ambush, threat alerts, restful sleep.

effects.name: Sanctified Rest
effects.description: Allies resting in the hearth are warded against nighttime ambush.
effects.mechanicsText: Ward against nighttime ambush; out of combat.

name: Beacon of Truth
description: Ignite your greatsword with Aex's unburied light for 1 hour. Illuminates hidden passages, invisible runes, and reveals undead or Wyrd entities in 60ft. Out of combat.

selectedEffects.name: Unburied Light
selectedEffects.description: Your greatsword ignites with Aex's light for 1 hour: illuminates hidden passages and invisible runes, and reveals undead or Wyrd entities within 60ft.
selectedEffects.mechanicsText: Reveal hidden/invisible/Wyrd within 60ft for 1 hour.

name: Starlight Interposition
description: REACTION: Interpose your starlight shield when an ally within 10ft takes damage, reducing the damage by 50% and generating +10 Fervor.

effects.name: Starlight Interposition
effects.description: Interpose your shield: the triggering damage is reduced by 50%.
effects.mechanicsText: Reduce ally damage by 50%; +10 Fervor.

name: Solar Beacon
description: Plant a pillar of consecrated starlight. Allies within 15ft gain +2 to saves and recover 1d6 HP per round. Deals sacred damage to undead/wyrd foes.

effects.name: Consecrated Ground
effects.description: Allies within 15ft gain +2 to saving throws.
effects.mechanicsText: +2 saves within 15ft.

name: Aegis of the Martyred Sun
description: Surround an ally in a blazing solar mantle. Absorbs 40 damage and retaliates with 2d8 sacred damage to any melee attacker.

effects.name: Solar Mantle
effects.description: Absorbs 40 damage and retaliates with 2d8 sacred damage against any melee attacker.
effects.mechanicsText: Absorb 40; melee attackers take 2d8 sacred.

customMechanic: Spends 25 Fervor. Absorbs 40 damage and retaliates for 2d8 sacred.

name: Solar Cataclysm Judgment
description: Call down the wrath of Aex's unburied light in a 30ft radius. Deals massive sacred and smashing damage, sundering all dark enchantments.

name: Starlight Cleave
description: Sweep a heavy 2H greatsword in a wide arc infused with Aex's song, cutting through enemy ranks and generating holy fervor.

name: Zealous Strike
description: A direct overhead greatsword smash that drives holy force into a single foe, staggering their posture.

effects.name: Staggered
effects.description: The target's posture is broken, leaving them exposed after the overhead smash.
effects.mechanicsText: Staggered posture.

name: Bastion Stance
description: Brace your greatsword or tower shield, locking your boots into the earth to gain +2 Active Soak die bonuses.

effects.name: Bastion Stance
effects.description: +2 to Active Soak Die rolls; cannot be forcibly moved or knocked prone for 1 round.

name: Radiant Guard
description: Channel Fervor into heavy bulwark plate, surrounding yourself or an ally with a pulsing barrier of starlight.

effects.name: Radiant Guard
effects.description: +2 bonus to Active Soak Die rolls and 10 temporary HP for 2 rounds.

name: Consecrated Sweep
description: Drag your glowing blade across the ground, igniting a 10 ft semi-circle of sanctified ground that burns Wyrd-tainted foes.
customMechanic: Ground burns for 2 rounds; enemies ending turn inside take 1d6 sacred damage.

name: Zealot's Inquisitive Eye
description: Channel Aex's pure light through your eyes to detect Wyrd-taint in food, soil, or civilian bloodlines.

effects.name: Starlight Vision
effects.description: Gain Advantage on Perception and Investigation checks to detect Wyrd corruption for 10 minutes.

name: Fervent Charge
description: Rush up to 30 feet in a straight line with blade lowered, slamming into an enemy to knock them back and generate massive Fervor.

effects.name: Knocked Back
effects.description: The target is pushed 10 ft back by the slam.

customMechanic: Generates +20 Fervor. Target pushed 10 ft back.

name: Righteous Upheaval
description: Slam your greatsword into the volcanic earth, erupting a wave of starlight and stone in a 15 ft cone.

effects.name: Prone
effects.description: Knocked Prone on a failed STR Save.

name: Solvan Retribution
description: Inscribe a starlight cross on your chestplate. When an enemy hits you with a melee strike, release an immediate 10 ft radiant shockwave.

effects.name: Starlight Cross
effects.description: When an enemy hits you with a melee strike, release an immediate 10 ft radiant shockwave.
effects.mechanicsText: Melee attackers trigger a 10 ft sacred shockwave.

name: Chakram of Aex
description: Hurl a spinning disc of crystallized starlight 30 ft down a line, slicing foes before returning to hand.

name: Harmonic Smite
description: Requires Harmonic Stance (50+ Fervor). Strike with intense acoustic resonance, sundering 50% of the target's Passive DR.

effects.name: Sundered DR
effects.description: Target Passive DR reduced by 3 for 2 rounds.

name: Sanctified Hearth
description: Plant your greatsword into the snow or stone for 10 minutes, creating a 20 ft warm holy zone that melts ice barriers and shields allies.

effects.name: Sanctified Hearth
effects.description: Allies in 20 ft ignore sub-zero rime freezing hazards and gain Advantage on Constitution saves.

name: Beacon of Sol
description: Radiate blinding celestial starlight, forcing all enemies within 30 ft to target only you or suffer Disadvantage on attacks against allies.

effects.name: Compelled Focus
effects.description: Enemies have Disadvantage on attacks made against targets other than the Crusader for 1 round.

name: Reprimand of the Zealot
description: Interrupt an enemy casting a spell within 30 ft with a descending bolt of starlight lightning.

effects.name: Stunned
effects.description: Spell interrupted and target Stunned for 1 round on failed CON Save.

name: Starlight Bulwark
description: Project a massive prismatic barrier 15 ft wide that blocks all projectile spells and ranged arrows for 2 rounds.

effects.name: Starlight Bulwark
effects.description: All allies behind the barrier gain Full Cover against ranged physical and spell attacks.

name: Solar Flameblade
description: Infuse your weapon with holy volcanic flame for 1 minute, causing strikes to deal bonus ember/sacred damage and ignore physical DR.

effects.name: Solar Flameblade
effects.description: Melee strikes deal +2d6 ember/sacred damage and completely ignore enemy Passive DR for 1 minute.

name: Pillars of the Vigil
description: Call down 3 radiant starlight monoliths in target 30 ft radius, dealing sacred damage and pinning foes between them.

effects.name: Pinned Between Monoliths
effects.description: Foes caught between the pillars are pinned in place.

name: Shield of Light & Steel
description: Raise a massive radiant barrier granting +4 Passive DR and reflecting sacred retaliation at attackers.

effects.name: Light & Steel
effects.description: +4 Passive DR; melee attackers take 2d8 sacred retaliation damage for 2 rounds.

name: Supernova Surge
description: Vent all stored starlight zeal in a 30 ft radius explosion, blinding all foes and converting 100% of damage taken this encounter into bonus sacred burst.

effects.name: Blinded
effects.description: All foes caught in the burst are blinded.
effects.mechanicsText: Blinded by the starlight burst.

name: Solvan Judgment / Titanfall
description: Consume 100 Fervor to call down a titanic starlight hammer smash in a 20 ft radius, shattering Durability and DR and leaving permanent consecrated ground.

name: Avatar of the Willing Sacrifice
description: Transfigure your body into pure solid starlight for 3 rounds. Become immune to all damage, while all greatsword strikes trigger free Harmonic Smites.

effects.name: Avatar of Aex
effects.description: Immune to all damage types for 3 rounds. All melee attacks deal maximum damage and trigger free AoE starlight bursts.

name: Judgment Strike
description: Smite an enemy with righteous solar authority. Deals 2d8 sacred damage; the target suffers disadvantage on attack rolls made against anyone other than the Crusader for 1 round.

effects.name: Judged Stature
effects.description: Disadvantage on attack rolls against targets other than the Crusader.
effects.mechanicsText: Disadvantage on attack rolls targeting anyone other than the Crusader for 1 round.

name: Banner of the Solar Host
description: Plant a radiant solar battle standard in the earth, generating a 20ft consecrated aura for 3 rounds. Allies inside gain +1 to hit with weapon attacks and +5ft movement speed.

effects.name: Solar Host Inspiration
effects.description: +1 to weapon attacks and +5ft movement speed.
effects.mechanicsText: Allies within 20ft gain +1 on weapon attack rolls and +5ft movement speed for 3 rounds.

name: Shield-Wall Discipline
description: Lock shields into a defensive phalanx for 3 rounds. The Crusader and all adjacent allies gain +3 Damage Reduction and heavy cover against ranged attacks.

effects.name: Shield Phalanx
effects.description: +3 DR and heavy cover from ranged attacks.
effects.mechanicsText: Crusader and adjacent allies gain +3 DR and heavy cover against ranged attacks for 3 rounds.

name: Radiant Sun-Shackle
description: Cast blazing solar tethers around an enemy within 35ft. Target's movement speed drops to 0 on round 1 and is halved on rounds 2-3 (Spirit DC 15 negates).

effects.name: Sun-Shackle Restraint
effects.description: Speed reduced to 0 on round 1, halved on rounds 2-3.
effects.mechanicsText: Speed 0 on round 1, halved on rounds 2-3 on failed DC 15 Spirit save.

effects.name: Sun-Shackled
effects.description: Movement speed drops to 0 on round 1 and is halved on rounds 2-3.
effects.mechanicsText: Speed 0 (round 1), halved (rounds 2-3).

name: Aura of Righteous Zeal
description: Radiate incandescent solar brilliance across a 25ft aura for 3 rounds. Allies within gain +1d6 sacred damage on all weapon strikes, and invisible enemies inside are revealed.

effects.name: Zealous Weapon Infusion
effects.description: +1d6 sacred damage on weapon attacks; reveals invisibility within 25ft.
effects.mechanicsText: Allies within 25ft add +1d6 sacred damage to weapon attacks. Invisibility suppressed in aura.

name: Wrathful Sun-Smite
description: Empower your greatsword with blazing solar retribution. Next strike deals 6d8 sacred damage and knocks the target prone (Constitution DC 16 for half and resists knockdown).

effects.name: Righteous Knockdown
effects.description: Target knocked prone on failed Constitution save.
effects.mechanicsText: Target knocked prone on failed DC 16 Constitution save.

name: Aegis of the Vanguard
description: Interpose a towering translucent solar bulwark before an ally within 30ft for 3 rounds. Grants 25 Temporary HP, +2 DR, and immunity to forced movement.

effects.name: Vanguard Aegis
effects.description: 25 Temp HP, +2 DR, and immunity to forced movement.
effects.mechanicsText: Target ally gains 25 Temporary HP, +2 DR, and cannot be forcibly moved for 3 rounds.

name: Dawn Bastion
description: Erect a 20ft hemispherical dome of dawn light for 3 rounds. Allies within gain DR 6 against physical and elemental damage, and take half damage from area effects.

effects.name: Dawn Bastion Sanctuary
effects.description: DR 6 against all damage and half damage from area attacks.
effects.mechanicsText: Allies within 20ft gain DR 6 and take 50% reduced damage from area-of-effect abilities.

name: Pillar of Condemnation
description: Call down a vertical pillar of concentrated solar flame in a 15ft area up to 50ft away. Deals 8d8 ember damage (Agility DC 17 for half) and blinds enemies for 2 rounds.

effects.name: Blinding Solar Column
effects.description: Blinded for 2 rounds on failed Agility save.
effects.mechanicsText: Targets blinded for 2 rounds on failed DC 17 Agility save.

name: Radiant Transfusion
description: Channel blinding solar restorative power into an ally within 40ft. Restores 35 HP, cleanses 2 negative status conditions, and grants +10 Temporary HP.

selectedEffects.name: Solar Purification
selectedEffects.description: Cleanses 2 negative status conditions.
selectedEffects.mechanicsText: Removes up to 2 debuffs, poisons, or curses from target ally.

effects.name: Residual Radiant Ward
effects.description: 10 Temporary HP.
effects.mechanicsText: Target gains 10 Temporary HP for 3 rounds.

name: Blades of the Holy Crusade
description: Conjure a swirling cyclone of radiant greatswords across a 25ft radius for 3 rounds. Deals 8d8 sacred damage upon casting and 2d8 sacred damage to any foe ending their turn in the zone.

effects.name: Sword Vortex
effects.description: Foes ending their turn in the zone suffer 2d8 sacred damage.
effects.mechanicsText: Hostile creatures ending turn in zone take 2d8 sacred damage.

name: The Immortal Vanguard
description: Transform into an unshakeable solar bulwark for 3 rounds. Gain DR 10, cannot drop below 1 HP, and any damage dealt to allies within 20ft is halved, with the other half transferred to you.

effects.name: Immortal Vanguard Stance
effects.description: Crusader gains DR 10 and cannot drop below 1 HP; 50% ally damage within 20ft redirects to Crusader.
effects.mechanicsText: Crusader gains DR 10, cannot drop below 1 HP. 50% of damage to allies within 20ft transfers to Crusader.

name: Apotheosis of Sol's Light
description: Manifest as an incandescent solar avatar for 1 minute: six wings of light, 60ft flying speed, allies heal 15 HP at round start, and all attacks deal maximum damage.

effects.name: Avatar of the Unconquered Sun
effects.description: Flight 60ft, maximum damage rolls on attacks, and passive 15 HP round-start heal to party.
effects.mechanicsText: Fly speed 60ft; all damage rolls deal maximum values; allies within 30ft heal 15 HP at start of round.

transformationConfig.description: Transcend mortal form as an incandescent solar avatar with six wings of blinding light.

grantedAbilities.name: Wings of Blinding Light
grantedAbilities.description: Gain a 60ft flying speed.

grantedAbilities.name: Unconquered Radiance
grantedAbilities.description: All attacks deal maximum possible damage rolls.

grantedAbilities.name: Dawn's Tender Mercy
grantedAbilities.description: Allies within 30ft heal 15 HP at the start of each round.

name: Decree of the Sun King
description: Issue a supreme proclamation across an 80ft radius for 3 rounds: enemies prostrate before the Sun King (speed 0, no reactions, DC 20 Spirit negates) and cannot attack allies with less health than you.

effects.name: Prostration of the Unworthy
effects.description: Speed 0, no reactions, cannot attack allies with lower HP than Crusader.
effects.mechanicsText: Speed 0 and no reactions for 3 rounds on failed DC 20 Spirit save. Enemies barred from attacking allies with lower HP than Crusader.
